_why: ADR-0021 §D5 compliance countersign, binding condition 1 (FOLLOW-925).
The DPIA §13.1 (denial-log) and §13.2 (cross-session identifier) disclosure sentences,
BYTE-IDENTICAL as compliance signed them. These are the bytes the countersign rests on,
and ESC-051 is byte pressure on exactly the file that holds them — the failure mode this
record exists to prevent is a legally mandated sentence being trimmed, retyped or dropped
for one locale while the text moves out of the SDK bundle.
Captured 2026-08-09 at f80f41b7 from packages/sdk/src/ui/consent-banner.ts COPY — the
shipped state compliance signed on 2026-06-12 and countersigned in PR #703.
A Zod schema (ADR-0021 §D7) locks the SHAPE of consent-text.json; it cannot express byte
identity of one specific sentence. That is this record, and only this record.
Enforced by scripts/check-adr-0021-conditions.mjs. Editing a sentence here is a compliance
change, not a copy edit: it needs the sign-off path the original text had.
FOLLOW-1118 / ESC-071 (2026-08-24): `disclosure13_1` is no longer hand-maintained. It is
GENERATED from CONSENT_LOG_RETENTION_DAYS by renderDisclosure13_1() in
packages/shared/src/consent-retention.ts, which is the same constant the retention cron
(GET /api/internal/retention/consent-log) deletes by. Regenerate with
`node --experimental-strip-types scripts/check-consent-retention-sync.mjs --write`; that gate
fails CI if these bytes, the constant and the cron window ever disagree. The templates
reproduce the 2026-06-12 signed text BYTE-IDENTICALLY at days=7, so the only thing this
record changed on 2026-08-24 is the period itself, per the CEO ruling in ESC-071.

en.disclosure13_1: We record the fact of your consent decision — including a denial — for compliance and debugging purposes. This log is retained for 180 days and is then permanently deleted.
en.disclosure13_2: To remember your preferences across visits, we store a pseudonymous identifier in your browser for up to 90 days. This identifier is refreshed every 90 days and is deleted if you withdraw consent.

pl.disclosure13_1: Rejestrujemy fakt Twojej decyzji dotyczącej zgody — w tym odmowę — w celach zgodności i debugowania. Dziennik ten jest przechowywany przez 180 dni, po czym jest trwale usuwany.
pl.disclosure13_2: Aby zapamiętać Twoje preferencje pomiędzy wizytami, przechowujemy pseudonimowy identyfikator w Twojej przeglądarce przez maksymalnie 90 dni. Identyfikator ten jest odświeżany co 90 dni i usuwany w przypadku wycofania zgody.

es.disclosure13_1: Registramos el hecho de tu decisión de consentimiento — incluida una denegación — con fines de cumplimiento y depuración. Este registro se conserva durante 180 días y luego se elimina de forma permanente.
es.disclosure13_2: Para recordar tus preferencias entre visitas, almacenamos un identificador seudónimo en tu navegador durante un máximo de 90 días. Este identificador se renueva cada 90 días y se elimina si retiras tu consentimiento.
